svg.title: PiDP-11 I/O Expander multiline note reproduction

text.tspan: Single board operation is assumed by
Multiple boards may be connected in
series via J2, however one or more
address jumpers (A0, A1, A2) must be
fitted to avoid I²C bus conflicts.
